archive: 最新独立安卓客户端和书剑源码一键架站.zip
name: 书剑3
group_note: extracted from a nested zip (the outer archive bundled an Android client apk + this shujian3.zip source drop); no master-hash match to bxsj/bxsj1 or any other lib; native boot was clean but the WASM pass needed real fixes: (1) logind.lpc euid resets (seteuid(getuid()) -> seteuid(ROOT_UID)) for create()/make_body(); (2) check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds and byte-stepping loop, plus is_chinese()'s GBK byte-range check, both fixed to per-character codepoint checks; (3) named.lpc's byte-stepping banned-name loop fixed to per-character; (4) band.lpc got the standard loopback-allow guard; (5) payd.lpc (HTTP payment-callback daemon) had 4 functions with unconditional socket_* calls (setup/store_client_info/listen_callback/close_connection) gutted to no-ops per the whole-file-entry-point-disabling approach; (6) a genuine, previously-undocumented securityd.lpc bug: valid_read() unconditionally overwrote the driver-supplied `user` argument with this_player(), which for "load_object"/"include" funcs is meant to be master_ob (root) -- clobbering it with the low-privilege connecting player denied compiling ANY code (including USER_OB and every #include) while a fresh/unprivileged account was connected, blocking registration outright; fixed by excluding those two funcs from the override; (7) a second genuine bug in commandd.lpc's rehash(): its sscanf pattern hardcoded the pre-conversion "%s.c$" suffix, which never matches this project's renamed "*.lpc" files, so get_dir()-filtered command lists came back empty and EVERY player command (look/score/quit/anything) silently fell through to the default "what?" fail message -- fixed to "%s.lpc$". Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via a real registration + adm/etc/wizlist entry (plain-text wizlist mechanism, standard XKX/ES2-lineage securityd.lpc). Custom mobile-app protocol: `id,password,ciphertext,email` (comma auto-replaced with U+2551 ║) for login/register, then `gender║img║nickname` (literal ║ only) for character creation; an unconditional "ver1.0,<key>" + version-check banner prints at connect regardless of input.
